name: ArenaChartShape
description: Whether a ring chart keeps its hole or fills to the centre. An enum rather than an inner-radius ratio, because the ratio is a design decision the chart already owns. chart.ring-inset is a token and the 0.62 hole beside it deliberately is not, on the recorded ground that a multiplier deriving one dimension from another stays inline. A number here would hand that decision to the caller one value at a time.
